title: Homemade drumsticks from chair rungs
summary: He whittled broken chair rungs into drumsticks, with no idea about rolls.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: I didn't have no drumsticks. What I did have was a... [COUGHS]
What I did have, as I said, was the chair, like a chair that you sit in, an old broke-down chairs that wasn't no
good and Mother had 'em throwed out in the back yard. I'd go out there and get them, and take a cake knife, a knife and a fork...the knife, not the fork...
And I'd whittle them down on the end, make me think they was a drumstick, you know... I didn't know anything about rolling or all that stuff.
